violation_type.title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Have Coverage of at Least $300,000 For Each Occurrence of Negligence (26 TAC §744.203(1))
violation_type.short_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Have Coverage of at Least $300,000 For Each Occurrence of Negligence
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation's liability insurance on file is expired. The current policy was not available for review during inspection.    Minimum standards state operations must maintain liability insurance.

finding_variants.text: The operation's liability insurance on file is expired. The current policy was not available for review during inspection.    Minimum standards state operations must maintain liability insurance.
At the time of the inspection, the operation did not have current liability insurance on file.
At the time of the inspection, there was no proof of current insurance for the program.
A current copy of the operation's liablity insurance was not available to verify.  The last policy expired 12/10/2022.
The program doesn't have documentation of current lliability insurance for review.
